token_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the Notion Internal Integration Token (starts with ntn_ or secret_). The worker reads os.environ[token_env] at runtime — never store the token value here.

default_parent_page_id.description: Default parent page UUID for create_page when --parent-id is not specified. Must be a page shared with the integration.

env.description: Runtime environment. Controls attestation strictness: dev skips HMAC verification, prod requires WCP_ATTEST_HMAC_KEY.
